summary: Well-structured test suite organized by TDD cycles with strong coverage of core requirements. Covers all three retention policies, error handling, report generation, and CLI interface. Includes workflow structure validation and end-to-end act integration testing with exact value assertions. Main gaps: limited edge case coverage for timestamp formats and large inventories, missing some advanced policy interactions in unit tests (though covered in act cases), and minimal stress testing. Design is clean with good mocks (RecordingDeleter) and test helpers (make_artifact, write_json) but has some redundancy across policy test classes. Mock deleter and fixture quality are solid. Would reliably catch most regressions but not all edge cases.
